annotations.title: Write a message to Fordeal (the contact form)

description: The /kontakt form without the website: `name`, `email` (where the answer goes), `topic` general | support | cooperation | privacy and `message` (10 to 4 000 characters). The message goes as one notice to hello@fordeal.ai with the sender as Reply-To; a person answers by e-mail. The sender gets no automatic e-mail (the answer here is the confirmation of receipt, with `id`). The same message twice on one day answers the same id with `duplicate: true`. A shop that wants to be compared uses register_shop; a partner, the media or a creator may use send_cooperation_inquiry for a structured request. Public, no key; five messages a minute per caller.

email.description: Where the answer goes; never shown, never mailed by the form itself.

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the sender's address with a daily salt (the website computes it); counts the per-visitor limit. Never stored.

locale.description: Language of the page the person wrote from (cs, sk, en, …).

name.description: Who writes (a name or how to address the person).

nickname.description: Leave empty (spam trap: a filled value is discarded quietly).

topic.description: general = a question about Fordeal, a price or a shop; support = a problem with the website or the account; cooperation = partners, media, creators (shops register on /obchody); privacy = a request about personal data (GDPR: access, erasure, objection).
